title: Howard Zinn’s Outsized Life w/ Dave Zirin
author: CounterPunch Radio
content:
This week, journalist and author Dave Zirin joins Erik Wallenberg and Joshua
Frank to discuss his new biography of the late, great Howard Zinn. The book,
[_The People 's Historian: The Outsized Life of Howard
Zinn_](https://www.pilsencommunitybooks.com/item/ymASTSSKIbZEEUsVhtT4Iw),
chronicles the inspiring life of one of our greatest radical historians. Dave
is embarking on a [national tour](https://www.edgeofsports.com/books/the-
peoples-historian-the-outsized-life-of-howard-zinn/) in support of the book;
find out if he'll be in a city near you.

The post [Howard Zinn's Outsized Life w/ Dave
Zirin](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/08/11/howard-zinns-outsized-life-w-
dave-zirin/) appeared first on
[CounterPunch.org](https://www.counterpunch.org).
